global_notes: This tracker is a working artifact. It records the B-track refresh status of each Agent A phase. The 'pending_refreshes' list is for refreshes that have been opened as branches but not yet merged.

The 'agent_a_phase_log' is a historical record. It is updated as Agent A merges new phases. After B15, all 15 logged phases (51G-1 through 51N) have B-track refresh entries. Future phases will be added as they land.
The 'agent_a_ownership_list_for_reference_only' is included for Agent B's reference. Agent B NEVER modifies any file in this list. A refresh is a docs-only change.
A refresh is a normal B-track operation. It is not a code change. It is not a route change. It is not a service change. It is a docs/report-only change.

Phase 51N is checkpoint and Claude review preparation. Claude review is handled separately outside Agent B branches and is not represented as completed in this tracker. Do not interpret B15 or B16 as a Claude review result.

The 5 remaining inline hotspots (POST /projects/{code}/save-as; POST /scenarios/{id}/rename; POST /scenarios/{id}/archive; POST /scenarios/{id}/update-overrides; POST /scenarios/{id}/select) are tracked in B17 with expected future Agent A phase numbering 51O/51P/51Q/51R/51S. This tracker does not include the 51O-51S phases; they are future work.
